items.title: 14.15 Laws and regulations related to the atmosphere

blocks.text: Air pollution in Pakistan is controlled by laws and regulations (14.15.1) and by specific measures to reduce emissions (14.15.2).

blocks.prompt: Why are laws needed to control air pollution when the technologies to reduce it already exist?
blocks.explanation: Fitting converters, filters and scrubbers costs money that polluters have no reason to spend unless emission standards are enforced; laws set the standards, make them compulsory and allow penalties, so that the technologies are actually used.

items: Air pollution is controlled through laws and regulations and through specific control measures.
